notes:
- Fixed BGM/vocal isolation quality: real AI-based (Demucs) separation is now actually wired up and used when selected in Settings -> Vocal Removal Engine -- previously it silently fell back to a low-quality stereo-channel-cancellation trick even when "Demucs" was selected, with no error shown
- Added automatic FFmpeg detection across common Windows install locations (winget, Chocolatey, Scoop, Program Files) for both rendering and Whisper transcription
- Fixed hardware video encoder selection to verify the encoder actually works with a real test encode instead of trusting what FFmpeg reports as compiled in, fixing render failures on non-NVIDIA machines
- Fixed several VoxCPM2 voice-generation integration issues
- Reduced Whisper transcription minimum silence gap and added speech padding to cut down on clipped words at subtitle boundaries
- Cached GPU name and drive space lookups instead of re-spawning a subprocess on every settings check
- Various render pipeline reliability fixes (concurrent job file collisions, non-blocking video duration probing, subtitle path handling for filenames with special characters)
